body:
Nexus 0.1.0 是嵌入式通用平台的 **Source SDK 开发者软件预览**。平台源码固定在 [`58297516d707`](https://github.com/X-Gen-Lab/nexus/commit/58297516d707fdee117bd27b5df6af09d72edd2e)，应用示例独立维护。

- [双语在线文档](https://x-gen-lab.github.io/nexus/stable/) · [固定版本文档](https://x-gen-lab.github.io/nexus/versions/docs-58297516d707/)
- [应用示例](https://github.com/X-Gen-Lab/nexus-examples) · [平台集成 PR #9](https://github.com/X-Gen-Lab/nexus/pull/9)
- [源码 CI：29/29](https://github.com/X-Gen-Lab/nexus/actions/runs/38682470932) · [安全分析执行：4/4](https://github.com/X-Gen-Lab/nexus/actions/runs/38682470861) · [示例 CI：11/11](https://github.com/X-Gen-Lab/nexus-examples/actions/runs/38684311021)

本页 13 个附件包含源码 SDK、双语离线文档、来源证明和原始软件证据。`release-manifest.json` 记录完整附件集合及 SHA-256。

**独立下载验收已通过：**13 个附件全部核对；来源证明完成实际密码学验证；5,415 个原始源文件匹配固定源码与 9 个锁定依赖；SDK 移到包含空格的新路径后，7 个配置、10 个镜像、28 条命令全部成功，Native C／C++ 程序实际运行。

[交付与独立恢复证据](https://github.com/X-Gen-Lab/nexus/tree/0928f73809ca6bd3c9cae1f7d29f308db6bb201f/docs-release-0.1.0-58297516d707-final) · [发布运行](https://github.com/X-Gen-Lab/nexus/actions/runs/38687802092)

源码与发布构建器分开固定。`delivery-workflow.json` 记录两者身份；来源证明的签名工作流属于[构建器 `51bebd47`](https://github.com/X-Gen-Lab/nexus/commit/51bebd47dd63dce90c7fded1efafef27cd20fd3e)，SDK 源码另按固定提交逐项核验。

物理实板 HIL 为 `not_executed`。本版本是软件预览，不构成生产资格、安全认证、签名固件或 LTS 承诺。详细范围和历史证据缺口见交付记录。

---

Nexus 0.1.0 is a **Source SDK developer/software preview** of the common embedded platform. Source is fixed at `58297516d707fdee117bd27b5df6af09d72edd2e`; application examples live in a separate repository. The 13 assets include the SDK, bilingual offline documentation, provenance and raw software evidence. `release-manifest.json` binds the complete asset set and SHA-256 identities.

Independent public-download acceptance passed: all 13 assets matched; provenance was cryptographically verified; 5,415 original source files matched the fixed platform commit and nine locked dependencies. After relocating the downloaded SDK to a path containing spaces, seven configurations, ten images and all 28 commands succeeded, including actual execution of the Native C/C++ programs. See the evidence link above for raw records and restoration instructions.

`delivery-workflow.json` distinguishes immutable SDK source from the independently versioned delivery builder. The provenance signer identifies builder `51bebd47dd63dce90c7fded1efafef27cd20fd3e`; SDK source is established separately against the fixed source commit.

Physical HIL remains `not_executed`. This preview is not production qualification, safety certification, signed firmware or an LTS promise. Detailed scope and historical evidence gaps remain explicit in the delivery records.
